customer_question: How do I map fields from our web form trigger into a HubSpot contact? First name, last name and company should land in the right HubSpot properties, and lead source should always be 'Website'.
resolution: In the HubSpot 'Create or update contact' step, mapped each property to a trigger variable: firstname → {{trigger.body.first_name}}, lastname → {{trigger.body.last_name}}, company → {{trigger.body.company}}. Created a workspace variable lead_source = Website under Settings → Variables and mapped it as {{vars.lead_source}}. Run once confirmed the contact was created with all four properties.
